descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
About the project 
 You’ll work on the platform that takes new product designs and gets them ready for production for a global consumer brand. It’s a core system built by a small team, so you’ll have a real say in the architecture, the product and its direction.
 What you’ll do 
Build backend services and APIs in Python or TypeScript on AWS.
Own your services end to end, including infrastructure and deployment.
Contribute to frontend features in React, while your main focus stays on the backend.
Model a complex business domain together with product and design.
Work closely with other engineers through pair programming and knowledge sharing.
Use agentic AI tools in day-to-day development.
 What we’re looking for 
8+ years of experience in software development.
Strong backend experience with Python or TypeScript.
Hands-on experience with cloud services (AWS).
Solid software architecture: Clean Code, Hexagonal Architecture, SOLID, DDD.
API design: REST, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI.
Some frontend experience /interest with React, Angular or Svelte.
Clear written and verbal communication in English.
Curiosity about the business domain, proactivity and autonomy.
 Nice to have 
Infrastructure as code: AWS CDK, Terraform or CloudFormation.
Observability, monitoring and incident response.
CI/CD: Docker, GitHub Actions, automated testing.
Azure Entra ID, MSAL, OAuth 2.0 and JWT.
Temporal.io.
